text: Gardening involves creating a harmonious environment where plants and soil thrive. A crucial component is mulch, a layer of material spread on the soil surface to suppress weeds, retain soil moisture, and enrich the soil with nutrients. Compost, an organic matter-rich material, is added later to enrich the soil with essential nutrients and improve its structure. Both mulch and compost are vital in the gardening process, ensuring that the soil remains fertile and the garden remains lush and vibrant.
